CustomField.description: When checked, this row force-overwrites every field it specifies on the Journal Entry Line, including GL Account. When unchecked, attribution fields overwrite but GL Account is only filled when blank.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked: this row's values overwrite everything it specifies on the matched Journal Entry Line, including the GL Account from Ramp's coding. Unchecked: Vendor, Employee, GL Variables, Project, Project Task, and Product overwrite, but GL Account is set only when the line has none.
CustomField.label: Override
